scope: Selection, Onshape shortcuts, sketch regions, and navigation baseline before the subsequent settings/assembly work
platform: Pixel native Debian ARM64 Linux desktop, using the existing pixel-gpu launcher
source_consistency: Windows source and extracted Pixel source fingerprints matched before the final baseline build
native_gui_verified: Plain clicks accumulate faces; another click removes the target; Space clears
Faces, edges, and parts filters select the intended target types
Muted turquoise selection and purple hover remain distinct over a black viewport; count badge has a dark background
Filter labels remain on one line, including Sketch regions
S opens focused command search; typing fillet then Enter starts Fillet
Shift+1, Shift+5, and Shift+7 select Front, Top, and Isometric
N aligns a hovered planar solid face and repeats to its opposite normal
With no selection, N aligns a hovered read-only sketch and Y hides that sketch
Extrude editor opening and Fit include the complete input sketch, including unselected regions
Region checkboxes and viewport clicks add/remove individual regions; adjacent selected cells regenerate as one solid
Clearing regions disables Apply and Enter; selecting a region recovers the preview
Lens curved and vertical boundary edges are selectable; a rim Fillet of radius0.2 previews, applies, and saves
G draws a corner rectangle; R draws a center rectangle; C draws circles
Two circles select without modifiers; E adds Equal and reduces sketch DOF14 to13
D places a driving diameter2; both Equal circles update and DOF13 reduces to12
Shift+E finishes the sketch and opens Extrude with its four regions; Enter applies and Ctrl+S saves
Closing during an unsaved sketch edit shows the guard; Keep editing preserves the edit; Cancel reverts that temporary edit
The saved native-designed document stayed byte-identical after the close/keep/cancel test
